# glad

The OpenGL loader, generated by [glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) 2.0.8
for OpenGL 3.3 core with no extensions: everything the renderer calls, and
nothing more. It is checked in rather than generated at build time, so a
build needs no Python.

To regenerate it, from a checkout of glad at `v2.0.8` (the generator needs
Python with `jinja2`), in this directory:

```bash
python -m glad --api gl:core=3.3 --extensions= --reproducible --out-path . c
```

or use the web generator with the same settings:
<https://gen.glad.sh/#api=gl%3Acore%3D3.3&extensions=&generator=c&options=>.
`--reproducible` keeps timestamps out of the output, so the same settings
always give the same files.

Licences: the generated `gl.h` and `gl.c` are `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND
Apache-2.0`, as their headers state; `KHR/khrplatform.h` is Khronos' MIT-style
licence.
